description: Context-specific actions with compact equipment (REQ-002; C03, C06, C07) delivered through MovementIdentity / WorkoutCard / ReviewMovement / LiveMovement (src/ui/refinements/movement.tsx, src/ui/refinements/workout-card.tsx), adopted by BlockPanel and the Review section on the real /review and /workout routes (JOURNEY-002), with the accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=cards (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d). Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-002 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/movement-identity.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false

cases.name: TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > AC-C03-01 shows the compact equipment beside each movement name in Review and Workout, as readable wrapping text
TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > AC-C06-01 offers Swap in Review’s movement slot and set progress, Rest and logging in Workout’s, never the other way round
TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > AC-C07-01 heads Review’s block cards with the live cards’ static header: the section identity and the badge, in the same face
TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > AC-R002-01 says a duplicate Bodyweight once, by the equipment, in both contexts and never hides an actual prescribed load

TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > AC-R002-02 keeps Review’s sections open under static semantic headings, with no toggle, chevron or hit area, and keeps the separate disclosures

TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > AC-R002-03 keeps planned sets, reps, rounds and rest in Review, keeps live counters and Rest or log controls out of it, and keeps Swap out of Workout
TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > JOURNEY-002 opens Review, uses Swap, starts that same workout and uses Rest on Workout without recording work
TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > JOURNEY-002 timed formats show the same equipment beside each name in Review and in the live EMOM, AMRAP and For Time blocks
TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > JOURNEY-002 recovery: a failed alternatives read or a failed Start keeps Review as planned and records no work
TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > renders the shared owners with each context’s own slot
TASK-002 context-specific actions with compact equipment > renders the accepted gallery state cards through WorkoutCard with static headers and each context’s slot
